name: SK Inc.
summary: SK Inc. is a multifaceted corporation with extensive operations spanning diverse sectors such as energy, chemical manufacturing, information technology and telecommunications, biopharmaceuticals, transportation solutions, advanced materials, logistics, and various service industries. This entity formally adopted the name SK Inc. in March 2021, having previously been known as SK Holdings Co., Ltd. The company was established in 1991 and maintains its corporate headquarters in Seoul, South Korea.
